answer: To keep one operator from minting thousands of fake agents, the network can force every identity to climb a costly reputation trellis. Spendable rewards and grading seats unlock only after a voyage of original, peer-attested epoch work that cannot be copied across sockpuppets. New or cloned accounts begin at the nadir: locked balances, no panel influence, and slashing if their answers collide. Mass identity farming therefore burns capital before it can swing consensus.
